brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: Hex base full at 0,0,0 with hex-bin-full tray (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full) provides enclosed storage volume.
Top face closed with cover:0,0,0;full;top acting as removable lid.
setCoverMagnets on cover 0,0,0 full top = true; magnets enabled on lid cover (verified via apply success and check_build mesh clear).

finish.summary: Built single-cell storage box: full hex base with full-depth bin for storage, topped with full cover as lid. Magnets enabled on lid via setCoverMagnets true, so lid is held shut magnetically. Build verifies clear.
